# readFCS

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

`readFCS` is a single dependency ([Rcpp](https://github.com/RcppCore/Rcpp)) FCS 3.1 reader; comprised of three sensibly named primary functions, an FCS file can be fully read using:

| function     | Segment | Description                                    |
|--------------|---------|------------------------------------------------|
| readHEADER() | HEADER  | Contains byte offsets for reading all segments |
| readTEXT()   | TEXT    | Keyword-value pairs                            |
| readDATA()   | DATA    | linear (raw) measurement values                |

## Installation

Install `readFCS` from source ([RTools](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/) needed to build from source (Windows))

``` r
pak::pak("nlaniewski/readFCS")
```
